notes.title: First 10.0 part IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
What's New

New Monster + New Places
The New Monster is THE MINI WENDIGO, a skinny deer but not less danger
The New place is The Catacombs, part of the Cavern of Insanity, also I added new floors to the Tower and a new section to the Unknown Area.

Survival Mode Reimagined
Now with a bigger house, there's a new problem!
Wendigo will no longer open windows, he's now going to watch you throw them and the more he watches you, the more you get insane.
Now with an implacable AI that will be always making everything to make your sanity fall, he'll make each night become harder and harder, appearing in unexpected places and taking down the lights.
The old survival mode is still playable for now, just click in the button saying "wendigo".

Optimized Graphics + Better Interfaces
Now the game it's darker and more optimized, it keeps requiring good software, at least an Nvidia graphics card or equivalent, and a mid-end Ryzen processor or equivalent.
Also the offers a better design to the widgets to make you feel like you're in a AA game.

Stats System
Do you feel like the interface is too cluttered? Click TAB and it will disappear.
Now Hungry/Stamina/Health system is working properly, now you can take damage by stepping a mine, getting a shoot, getting attacked by a military, by falling and way more ways to get damaged, but you have medickits!

notes.title: Wendigo's Outside News
notes.content:
Something new is upcoming...10.0 & The Fort
I've been working hard in wendigo's outside franchise last week and I'm here to announce new stuffs such as:
10.0 Update
I talked about this update in the last post, it will feature new designs, bug fixing and new content.

Take a look: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3296160/

Also here's a new area to the cavern, the military bunker;



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288600/ab6054fbc04b055e1146d285e99782dfc5441d5c.png"]
New Wendigo Design Prototype.
Sometime ago I shared a new wendigo design at X (old Twitter): https://x.com/StudiosGam38936/status/1913216775673594360

Well now here's a new one:



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288600/b4af527b31cede73a5dd4b8ec6ea018c6fab30e3.png"]

The Fort is still underwork, it will have a short-medium duration session, it's all to the fort for now.
Multiplayer Mode & Map Editor
Those are only concepts but basically the Multiplayer mode will be based on Horror Brawl from Keplerians, an mobile multiplayer horror game.

In this multiplayer mode (it's FFA), it will be 4 (or more) players, and there will be 4 generators, the players have to reach the generators, turn them on and then escape into the portal, the first person entering the portal win the game, but as much as people kill each other and complete the missions, they will receive special objects that will allow them to turn into Wendigo, Foxer or a Military for a determinated time.

The creation mode will be based on Piggy Build Mode & Mario Maker, the player will be allowed to build a map in a determinated theme, for example cavern, laboratory, forest, etc...

Then he can place floors, walls, enemies, resources and any content from the game.

Multiplayer Mode will be released as part of the game while the Map Editor, possibly, will be released as a separated DLC.



Also there's the official site released a day ago: https://wendigos-outside-site.netlify.app

notes.title: 9.1 IS HERE NOW
notes.content:
What's new???
Bug Correction
Pause Menu wasn't working at some points
At the Forest, Cavern, Wheel, Laboratory, Tower and Unknown Area, the pause menu wasn't working correctly due a input problem that was reading the keybind "PAUSE" instead of the keybind "ESC".
Survival Mode wasn't opening correctly
Somehow, the survival mode wasn't working sometimes, well now you can play this mode properly.

10.0 NEWS/Spoils
10.0 will be the last Wendigo's Outside update before The Fort and it will bring
New and Updated characters
Salvatore, Robert and the Slaves will use a new tech
Those characters will be made at MetaHuman Creator, here's a sneakpeek:
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GvfYPJRXoAA8Kk8?format=png&name=small
Possible new Wendigo and New Foxer
Both of the characters will get scarier (it's only a possibility)
Good NPCs
During the Unknown Area or the Cavern there will be an high possibility to see some slaves alive working and talking to make the atmosphere tense.
More Expansions/Chases
Unknown Area
One of the most important places in the lore will be more explored.
Cavern of Insanity
This place as an high potential to get bigger and more realistic.
New Confronts/Chases
Nothing to say for now... shhhhh
Controller Support
XBOX and Playstation
As you maybe know, you can play with a controller but there's a big problem, to interact with interfaces you need a mouse/keyboard, well that will be fixed
Wendigo's Outside to consoles
Soon Wendigo's Outside can migrate to consoles and (it still at debate) to Mobile (Android/iOS)
Full bug correction
Every single bug will be properly analyzed and fixed
IT WILL COME WITH THE FORT TEASER TRAILER
Yup, The Fort's teaser will release with the 10.0 update
When will it come???
10.0 as no previews for now, but you can expect it to release this summer vacations!
But remember, it's only an expeculation

notes.title: WENDIGO'S OUTSIDE 7.0 is here now
notes.content:
What's new???
Bug Correction
Some Bugs are now unexistent


Grab: The New Minigame
After sometime, the last minigame is there!
It is simple, the player needs to collect 386 floating watermelons while Wendigo is after him, a Pac-Man styled minigame

Upgraded Forest
I wasn't that happy with the initial concept of the forest, well, now the forest is way different and you can explore new stuffs, collect new achievements and run away from the enemies

New Enemy Type + AI Changed
Some AIs got modified, Wendigo and Foxer now can run and kill the soldiers, soldiers, when they get spotted by a monster start running for they're lifes and there's a new type of soldier, the shooter, he'll try to shoot the player with a riffle

Updated Interfaces
Some Interfaces are now changed to be better

Smooth Gameplay
Some stuffs to make the gameplay look better got changed, camera shake when landed, better drink/food system, run shake changes and better aim for example
